title: Hillcrest Gardens Apartments
addressLine: 4180 Terrace Crest Dr, San Diego, CA 92108
positioning: 48 units in Mission Valley — the upside is in the rent roll.
overview: Hillcrest Gardens Apartments brings 48 units to market at a 6.33% cap on in-place income. In-place rents sit roughly 8% under market across both floor plans, and occupancy has held at 93.6% through the trailing period.

location.blurb: Mission Valley sits at the center of San Diego's freeway and trolley network, minutes from both employment cores and the coast — a submarket where stable occupancy meets steady rent growth.
